related_adrs: ADR-0565 (zero GraphQL in the owned API surface)
ADR-0632 (public product protocol and internal RPC posture)
title: API contract single-source-of-truth — public REST, events, and realtime plus internal gRPC (ZERO GraphQL per ADR-0565)

zero_graphql.decision: ADR-0565 — the owned API surface carries NO GraphQL (no REST-named husk, no generated BFF). Public surfaces are REST/OpenAPI, versioned webhooks, AsyncAPI events, SSE, and WebSocket; gRPC/proto3 and gRPC streaming are internal-only per ADR-0632.
zero_graphql.reintroduction_rule: GraphQL is admissible ONLY via a future ADR that explicitly reverses ADR-0565. Absent that ADR, any GraphQL library, .graphql/SDL artifact, or resolver is forbidden in the owned stack and enforced by the cloud-ci-no-graphql-without-adr gate.

purpose: Target spec for the shared Rust-native contract SSOT and drift gate. Public REST/OpenAPI 3.2.0, versioned webhooks, AsyncAPI 3.1.0 events, SSE, and WebSocket plus internal-only gRPC/proto3 and gRPC streaming are GENERATED or VALIDATED from one shared Rust-native source of truth so the surfaces cannot drift. GraphQL, public gRPC, gRPC-Web, and Connect are not part of the owned public surface set. Honest non-claim: this records the canonical contract-SSOT model and launch directives; it does not implement generators, brokers, adapters, or the runtime drift gate.

single_source_of_truth.form: Rust-native typed contract definitions are canonical; public OpenAPI 3.2.0 and AsyncAPI 3.1.0 plus internal proto3 are projections generated or validated from them
single_source_of_truth.principle: one source mastered in exactly one place; public and internal wire surfaces are derived projections, never independently hand-edited (SSOT single-master).

surfaces.derivation: generated from the Rust source; api-semver gate enforces -vN suffix + metadata (ADR-0342)

surfaces.transport: gRPC over HTTP/2 with SPIFFE-shaped mTLS and TLS 1.3
surfaces.derivation: generated from the Rust source; tonic/prost adapters consume the generated bindings
generated/validated from the Rust source where events are typed; versioned webhooks use the stable CloudEvents HTTP binding where CloudEvents envelopes are selected

surfaces.artifact: public SSE (one-way server push), public WebSocket (bidirectional), and internal-only gRPC-streaming bindings
surfaces.derivation: the realtime transports project the same Rust-native typed payloads; no separate hand-maintained schema and no stable CloudEvents WebSocket binding is claimed

drift_gate.name: api-contract-ssot-drift (planned)
drift_gate.rule: regenerate the projections from the Rust source and diff against the committed contracts; any divergence (REST/gRPC/async out of sync with the source) fails the gate (lockfile-style, like cargo's Cargo.lock check).
drift_gate.ci: runs as a Buck2/Rust cloud-ci gate behind the single protected oya-ci-required context (ADR-0515)

messaging_directives.async_contracts: AsyncAPI 3.1.0 for event contracts, also derived from the shared source where events are typed

non_claims: Records the canonical contract-SSOT model + launch directives only.

Does NOT implement the Rust-native generators, the OpenAPI/proto/AsyncAPI emitters, the realtime (SSE/WebSocket/gRPC-streaming) bindings, the drift gate runtime, message brokers, adapters, or admission controllers.
No runtime, no production readiness; claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
